Full EnglishJobs description for the Data Analyst role. In this role you will join an international reporting team and work with business stakeholders to understand data requirements, prepare recurring KPI reports, and improve dashboard quality. Responsibilities include cleaning source data, validating report outputs, reconciling operational records, documenting assumptions, and communicating findings in a clear way for finance, service, and operations teams. Your tasks include building SQL queries, maintaining Excel checks, preparing Power BI reporting inputs, reviewing data quality issues, and supporting monthly performance reporting. The successful candidate will have experience with analytical workflows, structured problem solving, stakeholder coordination, and careful documentation of data lineage. Requirements include practical SQL knowledge, strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business questions into reliable analysis. Qualifications in data analytics, business reporting, information systems, or a related field are helpful. We value a candidate profile that combines hands-on reporting experience with curiosity, communication, and ownership of data validation tasks. Benefits include a collaborative team, hybrid work options, learning opportunities, and exposure to cross-functional reporting projects. The job offers a practical path to develop data analysis skills while working on real business metrics, dashboards, and process improvements.
